question: Shree Hanuman Vyayam Prasarak Mandal is situated in ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amravati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

__
 
• Shree Hanuman Vyayam Prasarak Mandal is a premier institute of sports and Physical Education in India.
 
• It is founded during the freedom struggle to instill in youths the spirit of patriotism and to propagate an ancient indigenous system of physical culture and sports. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Shree Hanuman Vyayam Prasarak Mandal was set up in Amravati. Earlier it was referred to as Hanuman Akhada. It was founded by the Vaidya Brothers namely Anant Krishna and Ambadas Krishna in the year 1914, as a small Hanuman club.

 
• To link up the movement of physical education with the National Freedom Movement.
 
• To modernize and systemize the traditional Indian System of exercise by incorporating it into the Western method of physical education.
 
• It is registered under the Bombay Public Trust Act 1950 and Societies Registration Act 1860.
 
• It is a Voluntary, Social, Non-Political & Secular Institute, managed with democratic principles & practices.
 
• Vaidya brothers got the inspiration to start this club from Veer Vamanrao Joshi, the great patriot of the Vidarbha region.
 
• The Vaidya brothers while founding the Hanuman Club had two clear objectives in view.
 
• One was to link up the movement of physical education with the national movement of the Indian renaissance and the second was to modernize and systematize the traditional Indian system of exercises in such a way as would bring in bold relief the best and knowledgeable elements inherent in it.

Thus, it is concluded that in 1914, Hanuman Vyayam Prasarak Mandal was set up in Amaravati.
